key_insight: ClinFusion is a vision-centric multimodal LLM that fuses 2D and 3D medical images with language to improve holistic medical understanding and clinically grounded evaluation.
clinical_relevance: It aims to support radiology-style tasks such as visual question answering, report generation, and instruction following with more accurate, fine-grained, and fact-focused outputs.
method: Uses a compositional, cascaded vision encoder to combine diverse 2D and native 3D medical image inputs.
Introduces a Cascade Spatial-Aware Locality Fusion operator to merge multi-scale visual features inside a unified encoder.
Adds a vision-grounded evaluation suite, including MedIF-Bench and a region-of-interest-grounded report metric.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art results across 2D and 3D multimodal medical benchmarks, plus a blinded radiologist review that ranked ClinFusion’s reports highest and found its RoI-grounded metric best aligned with expert judgment.
watch_item: Clinical deployment may still depend on robust validation across sites, modalities, and workflows before the model can be trusted in real-world practice.
paper_title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
